## BaseBrokerageGateway

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.Execution.Adapters.BaseBrokerageGateway</code>. Kind: `class`.

Source: [src/Meridian.Execution/Adapters/BaseBrokerageGateway.cs:17](../../../../src/Meridian.Execution/Adapters/BaseBrokerageGateway.cs#L17).

Base class for live brokerage gateways. Provides shared infrastructure: connection lifecycle, reconnection with exponential backoff, execution report streaming via bounded channels, and rate limit scaffolding. Concrete implementations override broker-specific methods.

## PaperTradingGateway

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.Execution.Adapters.PaperTradingGateway</code>. Kind: `class`.

Source: [src/Meridian.Execution/Adapters/PaperTradingGateway.cs:30](../../../../src/Meridian.Execution/Adapters/PaperTradingGateway.cs#L30).

Simulated order gateway that routes no real orders to any exchange. Orders are matched against observed market data under PaperOrderMatchingPolicy: market orders fill from the observed bid/ask/trade/bar in effect, limit orders fill only at or better than their limit price, stop orders trigger per the documented trade-preferred policy, and unmarketable orders rest and re-evaluate as new market data arrives. Commission, fee, and slippage costs from PaperTradingCostModel apply to every fill. Market orders with no observed reference price are rejected unless scaffold notional pricing is explicitly enabled via PaperTradingGatewayOptions.AllowScaffoldMarketFills. Implements ADR-015.

```csharp
public sealed class PaperTradingGateway : IOrderGateway, Interfaces.IPaperFillEvaluationTrigger
```

## WalTradeFillPostingStore

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.Execution.Events.WalTradeFillPostingStore</code>. Kind: `class`.

Source: [src/Meridian.Execution/Events/TradeFillPostingStore.cs:153](../../../../src/Meridian.Execution/Events/TradeFillPostingStore.cs#L153).

Execution-owned fill handoff backed by a scope-partitioned WAL and an atomically replaced pending-state snapshot. The snapshot is written before acceptance is reported, so a transient WAL append outage still leaves a fail-closed retained handoff that can replay after restart. Periodic WAL commit/truncation bounds completed history while pending fills remain lossless.

public sealed class WalTradeFillPostingStore : ITradeFillPostingStore

## IPaperFillEvaluationTrigger

Source: [src/Meridian.Execution/Interfaces/IPaperFillEvaluationTrigger.cs:9](../../../../src/Meridian.Execution/Interfaces/IPaperFillEvaluationTrigger.cs#L9).

Implemented by paper gateways that hold resting limit/stop orders. The host&#x27;s market event tap pokes this after recording new market data for a symbol so resting orders are re-evaluated against the fresh observation without polling. Implementations must be non-blocking: evaluation work is scheduled, never run inline on the market data path.
